issues.description: Milkable.messageOnMilk signature is inconsistent: the problem statement specifies messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) (including volume in the output), but the UML diagram, template Main usage, and the solution interface/classes define and call a no-argument messageOnMilk(). Students cannot know which method signature/output to implement to satisfy both statement and provided code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the problem statement to require messageOnMilk(): String (no parameters) and remove the milkVolume/volume formatting requirement, or (B) update UML, template Main, and solution (Milkable, Seal, Goat) to messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and adjust all call sites and expected output accordingly.
